BookScan doesn’t have a romantasy category, but the big driver in romance was the romantasy favorite _Onyx Storm (Wing and Claw Collection)_ by Rebecca Yarros, which sold nearly 1.7 million copies during the year. The standard edition of _Onyx Storm_ sold another 573,000 copies.

...
